summary: Cloud data platform for warehousing, analytics and AI workloads on shared data.
access_note: 30-day trial with free credits; an upgrade to paid is needed after that.
blocker_note: Only a time-limited trial is free; ongoing use needs a paid account.

evidence.quote: When you send a request, the request must include authentication information.
The trial continues for 30 days (from the sign-up date)
The Snowflake SQL API is a REST API that you can use to access and update data in a Snowflake database.
The Snowflake-managed MCP server lets AI agents securely retrieve data from Snowflake accounts.

notes: Auth options listed on the page: OAuth, key-pair JWT, workload identity federation; PAT inferred from a header value. MCP server is per account and must be configured in the account (URL is account-specific). Snowflake also has other REST APIs not read.
